claims.statement: EMA GDP requires correct storage during transport, tracing, and recall capability, while its Q&A says transport conditions should be validated or monitored with suitable temperature devices. A founder can seek SOP-level acceptance of a sensor-linked shipment record from a wholesaler's responsible quality person; that acceptance is not yet obtained.

A temperature fluctuation during storage or transport is an auditable event that can force quality review, delay release, or leave stock unusable if stability cannot be supported. EMA explicitly requires monitoring; the incidence and write-off value of excursions in Polish specialty delivery are not public.

The payer hypothesis is an authorised wholesaler, specialty pharmacy, clinic, or courier using GDP quality and logistics budget per temperature-sensitive shipment. GDP clearly assigns distribution controls, but it does not show a buyer will replace existing loggers with a cross-party claims rail.

contrary_evidence: Existing cold-chain couriers and data-logger vendors already provide validated sensors and portals.
A sensor trace alone may not determine product usability; product-specific stability data and a qualified person's judgment remain necessary.

economics.acquisition_route: Recruit one GDP consultant and one specialty pharmacy for a 100-shipment shadow pilot using rented tags; map every excursion to the existing deviation SOP before attempting automated release or insurance claims.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A device-neutral custody and excursion-decision rail could expand from Poland into high-value home biologic distribution, earning per-shipment and insurer integration revenue; scale depends on becoming accepted evidence rather than another dashboard.
economics.founder_time: About 10-15 hours per week for analytics and integrations; qualified quality personnel retain disposition decisions and couriers perform physical handling.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Per-shipment software margin after reusable tag depreciation, connectivity, and support; no margin assumes ownership of medicine inventory.
economics.payback: Target tag payback within 20-30 shipments and customer acquisition payback within a six-month logistics contract.
economics.pricing: Per monitored shipment plus a fixed monthly quality dashboard fee; later charge per accepted automated claim or insurer integration.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every shipment generates a trace, and embedded SOP plus historical lane-risk data create recurring use.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Lane-, packaging-, season-, and product-specific excursion outcomes accepted by quality and claims counterparties
fingerprint.customer: Specialty pharmacies, authorised medicine wholesalers, clinics, and GDP couriers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: GDP consultants, courier partnerships, and pharmacy wholesaler integrations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Device-neutral temperature custody record and deviation packet sold per shipment and by subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Quality or logistics team pays when a temperature-sensitive shipment is dispatched; claim workflow activates on an excursion
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A high-value medicine changes custody and its acceptable temperature history must remain provable

founder_fit: Anomaly detection, sensor data, and probabilistic lane scoring match the founder's data-science skills.
The founder's medical adjacency can help interpret workflows while regulated judgments remain with qualified professionals.
Reusable tags allow a small, measurable pilot without pharmaceutical inventory risk.
risks: Incorrect assurance could expose patients and create serious product-liability risk.
GDP validation requirements may make third-party sensors or software costly to qualify.
Incumbent couriers may refuse to share custody events or may bundle equivalent evidence.

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-shipment evidence rail for regulated custody and claims
structure.control_point: The SOP-accepted serialized link between sensor trace, custody events, and quality disposition
structure.critical_dependency: Acceptance by a responsible quality person and validated interoperability across couriers and logger hardware

thesis: Backcast from widespread home delivery of personalized biologics: secure the trusted custody record now, beginning with a device-neutral temperature deviation packet that quality teams and eventually insurers can act on.
title: Pharma Temperature Claims Rail
uncertainties: Excursion frequency, average quarantined value, and existing logger cost per Polish shipment are unknown.
A quality team has not confirmed that a standardized packet shortens disposition time.
It is unclear whether insurers will recognize the record for automated claims.
